trigger: Audit of the first M10W24B user-local package identified two reproducibility issues that do not change any signal formula, threshold, cohort definition, horizon, execution rule, cost model, split or decision tier: exact coverage-join completeness was not explicitly enforced/reported, and the implementation returned INSUFFICIENT_DENSITY before evaluating the already-frozen per-split REJECT rule.

allowed_corrections.exact_join_completeness: Require every M10W22 target-regime decision_time to match exactly one M10W14 coverage-grid decision_time before filtering coverage_class=NEITHER. Duplicate decision_time or any unmatched broader row must BLOCK. Report matched/unmatched counts and broader coverage-class counts.
allowed_corrections.classification_precedence: Apply the frozen M10W23 REJECT rule to any split whose resolved count is at least the frozen minimum_count_each_split and whose actual PF <= 1.0, or to all-sample fixed-$0.20 / +2bps PF <= 1.0, before using INSUFFICIENT_DENSITY for a different sparse split.
allowed_corrections.package_audit_metadata: Report that this is a postrun audit correction and that formula/threshold/cohort/metric rules were unchanged.

frozen_unchanged: M10W19 / M10P / M10P2 and all existing prospective starts
fresh_shadow_rule: Only an unchanged ROBUST_CANDIDATE or STRONG_CANDIDATE after the corrected audit may justify a brand-new fresh prospective shadow. Historical M10W24B remains research-exposed and is not final support.
